items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 32:1
items.html: There is no aspect of a coupling of striking except in the aspect of the screen in the Malchut of the head, but not in the screen that ends the Partzuf, for were the aspect of coupling to operate also in the ending screen, every Partzuf would need to spread without end. And all this is said only regarding the Partzuf itself; however, for the need of the lower one, which comes out only from the posteriors of the upper one, as is known, in the Partzufim of the GAR it is a screen of the chest, as in the Partzuf of AK, and therefore the head of every lower one comes out from the chest to the mouth of the upper one, and clothes the HGT of the upper one, as is known. However, in Yeshsut and ZON a change is made in this, for they come out only from the coupling of the Yesods of the upper one and not from the mouth, because they need the illumination of Hochma, namely, revealed Hassadim, which is not bestowed from the GAR of Aba and Ima, but only from their NHY, for the GAR of Aba and Ima are the aspect of covered Hassadim; and therefore Yeshsut do not receive the aspect of their Mochin except from the NHY of Aba and Ima. And likewise Yeshsut himself, after he is completed in all his Mochin, his GAR are also found in the aspect of covered Hassadim, like the GAR of Aba and Ima, and he does not bestow the aspect of revealed Hassadim except from the aspect of his NHY, like Aba and Ima. And likewise, after ZA is completed in all the Mochin, behold, he too is found to be in the aspect of covered Hassadim in his GAR, like Aba and Ima and Yeshsut, and cannot bestow the illumination of Hochma except in his NHY, like Aba and Ima.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 32:2
items.html: And for this reason it is found in Yeshsut and in ZON that they do not come out from the aspect of the screen of the GAR, which is drawn in the KHB HGT, but in the screen of the NHY, from where revealed Hassadim are drawn. And therefore the screen of the Yesod of ZA is made the aspect of a screen of the head for the Nukva, in the manner of the rule that all the posteriors of the upper one are made the front of the lower one, so that that same stature that comes out upon the coupling of the screen of the Yesod does not belong at all to ZA himself, but only to the Nukva. And therefore there is no change in his end because of this coupling, for from his own aspect the ending screen is there for all his illuminations, and he is not fit for any continuation of coupling. Rather, the matter of the coupling that is made is from the aspect of his posteriors, which belongs to the Nukva alone. And know that this is all the principal difference between the stature of AB of the direct light, which is from the Mocha Stima'ah, and the stature of AB that comes out upon the hairs of the beard, namely, the Hochma of the thirty-two paths. For the stature of AB of the direct light is drawn from the GAR of the upper one, as explained in the Partzufim of AK, that every lower one clothes the upper one from its mouth and below. However, the Hochma of the thirty-two paths comes out only from the NHY of the upper one.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 32:3
items.html: Indeed, there is here a great depth, which is worthwhile to elaborate upon, because its knowledge is necessary in order to understand these Mochin properly. And it is, that this Hochma of the thirty-two paths has no root at all in the GAR, but the Tifferet is the first root of this Hochma. And although Bina changed to be Hochma and not the Tifferet, for the Tifferet receives only an illumination from this Hochma; nevertheless, since the light of Hochma was not revealed in the Bina of the direct light, except with her emanation of the third aspect, which is the Tifferet, therefore only the Tifferet is discerned as the beginning and root of this Hochma, and not Bina; for in relation to the five aspects of the direct light, the second aspect, which is Bina, did not change because she emanated the third aspect, for only the third aspect, which is the Tifferet, received the illumination of Hochma, while the second aspect remained in the aspect of covered Hassadim, after the emanation of the Tifferet, as before its emanation. As is said above in Part 1, page 5, s.v. "and the reason". Behold, there is no root for this Hochma of the thirty-two paths in the GAR, for even Bina was not considered a root, as explained, but only the Tifferet alone is considered the root of the Hochma.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 32:4
items.html: However, it is known that the Tifferet includes the five Partzufim: HGT NHY, which correspond to the five aspects of the direct light, KHB ZON. And therefore it is discerned that also the HGT of the five Partzufim are above the aspect of the root of the Hochma of the thirty-two paths, for they are the aspect of KHB. However, the Tifferet of the five Partzufim is discerned as Bina in relation to the Keter, and as ZA in relation to AB, as is said in the previous parts; and from the aspect of the Mochin that come from AB, the Tifferet is considered the aspect of ZA. And therefore the Tifferet is divided into three thirds, which are: Bina, ZA, Malchut, which from the aspect of the correction of the lines are KHB HGT NHY, as is said in Part 13. There the upper third of the Tifferet, up to the chest, is the aspect of Bina and KHB; the middle third is the aspect of Tifferet and HGT; and the lower third is Malchut and NHY, as is said there. And according to what is said above, that in the GAR there is no root for the Hochma of the thirty-two paths, behold, also in the upper third of the Tifferet, which is the aspect of Bina and KHB, there is no longer any root for this Hochma, but only in the middle third, which is Tifferet and HGT, in which alone the root for this Hochma of the thirty-two paths is discerned. And with this you will understand what the Rav says everywhere, that the revelation of Hochma is only from the chest and below; the intention is to the middle third, which is discerned as the Tifferet within the Tifferet, as above, and therefore it is the root of this Hochma. And it is well explained that there is no root for the Hochma of the thirty-two paths, neither in the true GAR, nor even in the GAR of the five Partzufim, which are the HGT up to the chest, but only in the middle third of the Tifferet alone.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 32:5
items.html: And with this you will understand that also in Aba and Ima this matter of Hochma does not begin except from the aspect of their chest and below, for the ZAT of Aba and Ima come from the inclusion of ZON in them, as is known; and therefore also in them the HGT up to the chest are discerned as the aspect of GAR, and the Hochma cannot be revealed there, as above, but only from their chest and below, there the revelation of Hochma begins, namely, in their NHY, for from the chest and below is the aspect of NHY.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 32:6
items.html: (To the question) And therefore every Partzuf that needs to receive the Mochin of this Hochma of the thirty-two paths cannot receive it except from the NHY of the upper one; and they are three Partzufim: Yeshsut, ZA, and the Nukva; and therefore each one clothes the NHY of the upper one, and not the HGT, as in the Partzufim of AK, for only the GAR of the Partzufim of Atzilut, which are Atik, AA, and the upper Aba and Ima, which do not receive at all the illumination of the Hochma of the thirty-two paths, can receive from the coupling of the mouth of the upper one, and therefore clothe from the mouth of the upper one and below. However, the three Partzufim — Yeshsut, ZA, and the Nukva — which need this Hochma, receive only from the NHY of the upper one, whose principle is the Yesod; and since they need the coupling of the Yesods, they clothe only from the chest and below. And the matter of the coupling of striking made upon the screen of the Yesod is well explained: that it is completely similar to the coupling made in the screen of the mouth of the head, for just as the screen of the mouth serves as the aspect of the Emanator for the Partzufim of the GAR, so the screen of the Yesod serves as the aspect of the Emanator for the Partzufim of VAK, which are Yeshsut and ZON, for they receive only from the aspect of the coupling of the Yesods, as explained. (Item 77).
